## Founder-approved deltas applied to Git canon
1. Product line for current phase: free Growth Score → **$2,500 30-Day Growth Sprint** → optional Growth System.
2. Four-Surface Growth Model: Search/GBP, Website, Social, Reputation.
3. Cross-Surface Consistency Score is an overlay metric, not a fifth surface.
4. Consistency means alignment of services, positioning, proof and conversion path; not a simplistic same-keyword ranking theory.
5. Reputation layer uses compliant collection, not manufactured reviews. Neutral prompts are allowed; generated/prefilled/copy-paste patient reviews are not.
6. The imported Review Hub used rating-based public/private routing. That mechanism is **prohibited for CAESTHETIC** and retained here only as provenance. Any reuse must request feedback neutrally from every eligible client, without incentives, sentiment filtering, selective routing or review gating; private recovery may exist only as an additional path available to everyone.
7. With no VA, acquisition operations are AI-researched / founder-approved; source attribution is mandatory.
8. Supply remains separated from the cold/public US funnel and is not required for base-case economics.
